summary: The caller is known but is not allowed to do this.
description: The caller is known but is not allowed to do this. Distinct from `AuthenticationException`, which reports that the caller could not be identified at all.
Every class in this hierarchy takes an optional message, another exception whose message it reuses, or nothing at all. `isException` recognises all of them; a plain `Error` is not one.
